title: ZV-E1 2.02: C2 steps the rear-screen preview 3:2 -> 2:1 -> 2.25:1 -> 2.4:1 in movie mode and keeps the focus frames: VDF words and the frame widgets' expected rectangle, written from appFw
ported_from: lcdcycle_c2_v1 (A7C II 2.01; built and emulated, not run), itself lcdcycle_v6 (A7 IV 6.02; works on that camera, F858, F969); the 2.25:1 state from lcdcycle_s3_v3 (A7S III 5.01)
write_order: the patches in the listed order to apply (cave, then the hook); the reverse order to put back

triggers.0x2150003: EVENT_INPUT_KEY_TACT_CUSTOM2_ON (C2: the ZV-E1's rear key, 'Step zoom' by default)
triggers.0x2150006: EVENT_INPUT_KEY_TACT_CUSTOM3_ON (C3; this body has no C3 key)

cave.old_bytes: relocation entries of types [257] (257 = R_AARCH64_ABS64), applied by the loader when appFw.so is mapped and not read again
cave.why_not_after_the_segment: the first segment ends at 0x4afa87d: the 16-aligned tail of its last page is 1920 bytes; the routine needs 1460
cave.tail_note: not used: the second segment's file data starts at 0x4afa8f8, inside the first segment's last page

frame_rectangles.note: {x, y, w, h} u16 in a 640x480 grid, row 1 (rear panel) column 3 (16:9 picture) of the two tables (AF window, tracking); the widgets accept 5 units either way. 3:2, 2:1 and 2.4:1 are the values that work on the A7 IV (F969); 2.25:1 is (0, 80, 640, 320) by the same rule (height 480 x 1.5 / 2.25), not run on any camera

goes_with: a ZV-E1 open-gate state (not part of this design)
a ZV-E1 lcdfill: fit word 0x1f5c88 3 -> 0 and the two entries 0xe9b420, 0xe9b498 (0, 38, 640, 404) -> (0, 0, 640, 480): without the fill word a press does nothing
not_checked: on a camera: nothing of this design has run on a ZV-E1

that the key labelled C2 sends 0x2150003 (the name record is the same as on the A7 IV, where CUSTOM3 = C3 was seen on the camera; the ZV-E1 has CUSTOM, CUSTOM2, CUSTOM3, CUSTOM5 and CUSTOM6 events and two physical custom keys, C1 and C2)
that system mode 3 is movie on this camera (the accessor is found by call position; its field offset differs from the A7 IV's)
that dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT) finds libsencore's three functions in im.elf (the names are exported by this build's libsencore.so)
that the rear panel reports panel code 1 (3:2) and that the frame widgets use row 1 for it ([dev+0x244] non-zero, as on the A7 IV)
that the AF-window and tracking widgets are the only ones that compare the live-view rectangle (the A7C II's third, remote-send widget is not in this build)
the 2.25:1 rectangle (0, 80, 640, 320): derived, not seen on a camera
that the picture-ratio flag (bit 0 of its fourth argument; 1 selects 100/235) is 0 in the open-gate state, as on the A7S III
that nothing reads .rela.dyn after load on this camera (true of the glibc and musl loaders)
note: put back (level 20) removes the code; the coprocessor words stay in the mode last chosen until a cold boot. In movie mode the C2 key's assigned function (Step zoom by default) no longer runs (the press is turned into the ignored event); in stills C2 is normal
